name: cooling_tower_condenser_water
title: Cooling tower for the condenser water of a steam power plant
summary: Level-1 mass (dry air, water) and energy balances of a direct-contact cooling tower cooling condenser water from 65 °C to 30 °C with ambient air: air volume flow rate, make-up water flow rate and condenser heat rate.

authors: TBD (ULiège course Thermodynamique appliquée, S. Quoilin; repetition assistants N. Paulus and B. Dechesne per companion metadata)
origin.course: Thermodynamique appliquée (ULiège MECA0002), 2022-2023, repetition session R9, exercise 4

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file; the four asked-for unknowns are stored there as default guesses (file saved unsolved) and were verified by recomputation from the EES stored properties
verification.notes: 23 common variables, 8 differ (rtol=0.001); largest 5.98e-03 on w_ex (EES 10 vs CoolProp AirH2O humid-air backend, near saturation at 35 C; w_su/w_ex/h_a_su/h_a_ex within 0.3-0.6 %). Stored values 1 for m_dot_a_su/m_dot_a_ex/m_dot_add/V_dot_a_su are EES default guesses, not solution values: recomputed by hand from the stored EES properties, CoolSolve agrees within 0.40 %. Inputs, water enthalpies and Q_dot_cd exact. kPa/kJ converted by hand.
